summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, attaching a press release updating its germanium evaluation program at the Empire State Mines property. The filing reports district-wide germanium enrichment confirmed across multiple zones and tailings facilities, with sample results ranging from 4.5 to 85.6 ppm. No prices, premiums, or dates of a transaction are provided. This is a routine operational update on mineral exploration, not a special situation corporate event. As a non-US filer using Form 6-K, the filing serves as a periodic disclosure of material information, equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K for US domestic issuers.
